description: This file defines a composable Sidebar component for an Android TV application using Jetpack Compose. It manages the display and focus behavior of a vertical sidebar menu with items, including focus handling, scaling animation, and selection indicator.

classes.name: SidebarItem
classes.description: Data class representing a sidebar menu item with a label.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: Composable function rendering a vertical sidebar with focus and selection handling for each item.
